ideas.title: Bat Tornadoes for Cash 🌪️
ideas.hook: Tornadoes roll toward your town and you are the only one with a bat. Smack them away before they hit, and every twister you launch rains cash and loot on your plot.
core_loop: Wait on the edge of town as a tornado wave spawns
Time your swing to launch each tornado back over the hills
Collect the cash and debris that falls out
Buy bigger bats and swing upgrades
Survive longer waves for rare storm drops
ideas.twist: A missed tornado sucks up part of your town and you have to buy it back, so every swing has something at stake.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the fastest-rising mechanic at 2.69 momentum, led by Throw Food For Animals (459,635 CCU) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338). Disaster / weather is rising at 2.40 (up 0.81 this week) with Stop The Tsunami! (24,509).
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you hide from the storm; here the storm is the ball and you are the batter.

ideas.title: Tunnel Under the Horde 🧟
ideas.hook: The city above is overrun. Dig tunnels under the horde to reach supply drops, rescue survivors and get everyone to the evac point before your tunnels collapse.
core_loop: Dig through dirt, pipes and rock with your shovel
Pop up under supply crates and drag them down
Reinforce tunnels with planks you craft
Rescue survivors who follow you underground
Upgrade drills and push to deeper evac points
ideas.twist: Zombies hear digging. Loud tools are fast but draw the horde to dig in after you, so you trade speed for noise.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.63 momentum (up 0.65 this week) with Sandworm Playground (37,024 CCU). Break / mine / dig x Zombies is an open gap (score 3.07), and Zombies is rising at 1.20 with [UPDATE 2.1] 30 Floors Up (17,243). Interior maps are rising at 1.58.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about holding a base on the surface; this one moves the whole fight underground where digging is both escape and danger.

ideas.title: Bail Out of the Plane 🪂
ideas.hook: Your cargo plane is going down over a war zone. Sprint through the cabin, grab a chute and skydive past searchlights, flak and wreckage to land safe.
core_loop: Run through the shaking cabin dodging sliding crates
Jump out and steer the freefall through hazards
Pop the chute at the right height to land in the safe zone
Earn medals to unlock new planes and drop zones
Beat your fastest escape time
ideas.twist: Your chute only opens once. Open early and you drift slowly through flak; open late and you risk a ragdoll crash landing.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run x Military / war is an open gap (score 2.84). The Escape sub-genre is rising at 1.47 with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (24,341 CCU), Physics Sim at 2.56 with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (28,983), and Military is rising at 1.16 with Voxel Wars (27,834).
ideas.differentiator: Military games are about shooting; this one is a pure escape run where the weapon is gravity.

ideas.title: Armor Shop [Crash Test] 🛡️
ideas.hook: Run a castle armor shop where every knight tests the armor before buying. Ragdoll them with maces, catapults and dragons. If the armor holds, they pay.
core_loop: Forge armor pieces at your anvil
Strap them on a knight dummy at the test yard
Hit it with maces, catapults and dragon fire
Sell armor that survives for more gold
Upgrade the shop and unlock rarer metals
ideas.twist: Customers bring their own tests. A king may ask for armor that survives a catapult, so you have to build for the order.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop x Fantasy / medieval is an open gap (score 2.28). Sell / run a shop is rising at 1.22 with [💎] Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (29,386 CCU), and Physics Sim is rising at 2.56 with [🏢] Ragdoll Research (19,594). Fantasy is at 1.11 with Ragdoll Playground.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell static items; here the product demo is a ragdoll stress test, which is the fun part.

ideas.title: Draw a Ragdoll ✏️
ideas.hook: Draw any body you want and it comes to life as a ragdoll. Long legs, ten arms, a giant head. Then fling it off the launcher and see how far your creation flies.
core_loop: Draw a ragdoll body with a pencil tool
Watch the physics bring your drawing to life
Launch it at targets and distance markers
Earn ink to unlock bigger canvases and colours
Vote on the funniest ragdolls each round
ideas.twist: Bigger drawings weigh more, so a giant doodle smashes harder but flies shorter. You have to balance size and distance.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.62 (28 new games, spread out) with Kukirin Life [Testing] (20,403 CCU), and Hit / swing / launch is at 2.69 led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338). Physics Sim is rising at 2.56 and Giant / huge at 2.21.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games score your art; this one turns your art into the physics object, so a bad drawing is funnier than a good one.

ideas.title: +1 Hammer Size 🔨
ideas.hook: Every swing makes your hammer one size bigger. Start by smashing pebbles, then cars, houses, mountains and finally the moon.
core_loop: Swing at objects to gain +1 hammer size
Smash bigger objects for more loot
Unlock new zones that need a giant hammer
Rebirth for faster growth
Collect hammer skins in the index
ideas.twist: A giant hammer is slow. You can shrink it any time to swing fast on small loot, so you pick the right size for each target.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.77 with [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (26,045 CCU) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (15,710). Break / mine / dig is at 1.63 and Giant / huge at 2.21 with [🐶PETS] Raise The Biggest Family (23,011).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow your body; here the growing thing is your tool, and each size tier opens a new layer of the world to smash.

ideas.title: Grow a Car 🚗
ideas.hook: Plant a car seed and water it until a car grows out of the ground. Rare seeds grow sports cars and monster trucks. Harvest them and race your crop.
core_loop: Plant car seeds in your garden plot
Water and fertilise to grow parts (wheels, engine, body)
Harvest the finished car
Race it on the town track for cash
Buy rarer seeds and mutations
ideas.twist: Mutations change the car: a frost mutation adds ice tyres, a gold mutation doubles race cash. You breed seeds for the car you want.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is rising at 1.50 (45 new games, spread out) with [🐜] Ant Evolution (29,038 CCU) and [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution (17,917). The Vehicle Sim sub-genre is rising at 1.42 with Can You Pass A Driving Test? (25,800).
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Farming games sell crops; here the crop is a car you drive, so the harvest becomes the race.

ideas.title: Tie Down the Giant 🪢
ideas.hook: A giant is stomping toward the city. Your team fires grappling ropes at its arms and legs to pin it down before it reaches the walls.
core_loop: Spawn on the city wall with a rope launcher
Fire ropes at the giant's limbs and anchor them
Dodge stomps and swats as it fights back
Topple the giant for loot and medals
Upgrade launchers and unlock bigger giants
ideas.twist: Every rope you anchor is also a path. Teammates can run up the ropes to hit weak spots on the giant's back.
ideas.why_now: Giant / huge is rising at 2.21 (up 0.45 this week) led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338 CCU). Shooter is rising at 1.30 and Fight / battle x Shooter is a top pair (6 new games, 211,730 CCU). Arena maps are rising at 1.31 with Unstable SMP FFA [JAVA PVP!] (46,755).
ideas.differentiator: Shooters pit players against each other; this one points the whole server at one huge target that fights back.

ideas.title: Ram Walls for Gems 🛻
ideas.hook: Drive a monster truck through walls of stone, ice and gold. Every wall you break spills gems, and the next wall is always thicker.
core_loop: Pick a truck and floor it down the course
Smash through walls for gems
Bank gems at the end to buy engine and bumper upgrades
Reach thicker, richer walls
Unlock new trucks and course themes
ideas.twist: Truck damage carries over. Smash too many walls without repairs and parts start flying off mid-run.
monetization: Luck boost for rare gem walls
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig x Race / drive is a top pair (3 new games, 180,624 CCU). Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.63 with Sandworm Playground (37,024 CCU), and Vehicle Sim at 1.42 with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (21,503). The "___ for ___" formula is at 1.06 with [😈] Jump for Cases🎲.
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Crash games wreck cars for fun; here the crash is the mining tool, with a clear gem economy behind every wall.

ideas.title: Be a Meteor ☄️
ideas.hook: You are a meteor. Pick your landing spot, smash into towns, farms and cities, and every crash makes you bigger for the next impact.
core_loop: Steer your meteor through space dodging satellites
Slam into a planet target for damage points
Gain +1 size from what you destroy
Rebirth into rarer meteors (ice, gold, plasma)
Unlock new planets to hit
ideas.twist: Other players can be the planet's defenders, firing lasers to shrink you before landing, so every server mixes meteors and defenders.
monetization: Luck boost for rare meteor types
ideas.why_now: Space is rising at 2.56 (up 0.68 this week) with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (25,339 CCU), Disaster / weather at 2.40, and Hit / swing / launch leads all mechanics at 2.69 with Bloody Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (41,791). The "Be a ___" formula is at 1.39 with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend.
ideas.differentiator: Destruction sandboxes give you tools; here you are the disaster, and growing between impacts gives it a progression loop.
